name: souza-guedes-site-institucional
description: Build do CSS, das fontes e das imagens e auditorias (Lighthouse e navegadores) do site Souza Guedes Advogados.

scripts.build:css: node scripts/build-css.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i resources/css/app.generated.css -o public/assets/css/main.css --minify
scripts.watch:css: node scripts/build-css.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i resources/css/app.generated.css -o public/assets/css/main.css --watch
